description: The early-exit certificate holding non-trivially: the program HAS interprocedural boundaries - main calls twice(), so the call site, callee entry, formal-in and formal-out are all boundary vertices - but A's edit (int c = 3 -> 4) flows only into println(c), so AP_A stays boundary-free and the certificate licenses skipping the SDG passes. The harness asserts the licence is honest: the intra-procedural verdict must equal the interprocedural one here. Complements the intra fixtures (where the certificate holds vacuously - no boundaries at all) and the inter_* fixtures (where the APs cross a boundary and the certificate refuses).
category: agreement (early-exit certificate holds with calls present)
